definitions.explanation: A state of tranquility or freedom from war.

examples.japanese: {平和|へいわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{平和|へいわ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
{平和|へいわ}な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}りたい→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: I want to live a peaceful life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わって→終わる：00567_owaru⟧、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧{平和|へいわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{戻|もど}った→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。

examples.english: I'm grateful to have been born in a peaceful era and want to cherish each day.

notes:
{平和|へいわ} refers to a state of peace, tranquility, or freedom from conflict. It functions both as a noun and as a な-adjective.

USAGE:
- As noun: {平和|へいわ}を{守|まも}る (to protect peace)
- As な-adjective: {平和|へいわ}な{世界|せかい} (peaceful world)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {世界|せかい}{平和|へいわ}: world peace
- {平和|へいわ}な{時代|じだい}: peaceful era
- {平和|へいわ}を{願|ねが}う: to wish for peace
- {平和|へいわ}{条約|じょうやく}: peace treaty

RELATED WORDS:
- {平和的|へいわてき}: peaceful (な-adjective, emphasizes manner)
- {平和主義|へいわしゅぎ}: pacifism
- {戦争|せんそう}: war (opposite)
